projects.title: Han Finland Ecommerce
projects.description: A modern ECommerce website built for Han Finland to sell clothing and fashion products online. Developed with WordPress and WooCommerce, it features secure Stripe payments, product variants for different sizes and colors, and a fully responsive shopping experience. The store also includes inventory management, order processing, and an intuitive admin dashboard for managing products and customer orders.

projects.title: AlignVET
projects.description: A bilingual (Arabic & English) website built for AlignVET, a two-year vocational training project. Developed with WordPress, it features a responsive design, content management system, MailPoet integration for newsletters, and dedicated sections for training programs, events, news, and project resources.

projects.title: AMACO CMS
projects.description: A custom content management system (CMS) developed for AMACO to manage website content, blogs, projects, and services. Built with Go, Echo, HTMX, Templ, and MySQL, the platform provides a fast server-rendered experience with a Vue.js-powered block editor, interactive dashboards using Chart.js, and an intuitive admin interface for efficient content management.

projects.title: Ultra Academy LMS
projects.description: A modern Learning Management System (LMS) developed for Ultra Academy to showcase courses and provide an engaging learning experience. Built with Next.js and React, the platform features responsive design, smooth GSAP animations, interactive course pages, and intuitive navigation for students across all devices.

projects.title: SkyLimit CRM
projects.description: A web-based CRM platform developed for SkyLimit LLC to streamline customer management, communication, and payment processing. Built with PHP and Alpine.js, the platform features an intuitive dashboard, Voximplant VoIP integration for real-time calling, BitPay payment integration, and a responsive interface optimized for day-to-day business operations.

projects.title: API Empire
projects.description: Api Empire is a platform that provides various APIs for developers through subscription-based services.
